notes: Seafolly sells kaftans and cover ups worn over swimwear

name: Motorcycle helmet
definition: Helmet made for motorcycle riders.
notes: SHARP lists 67 motorcycle helmet brands with full face and system (flip-up) types

name: Cycling helmet
definition: Helmet made for riders of bicycles.
notes: Virginia Tech rates 311 bicycle helmets in road, urban, all mountain, multi-sport, full-face and e-bike types

name: Hard hat
definition: Rigid helmet made to protect the head at work from falling objects and impact.
notes: Discount Safety Gear sells MSA V-Gard hard hats, cap style and full brim, ANSI Type I and II

name: Welding helmet
definition: Helmet with a darkening visor made to protect the face and eyes of a welder.
notes: Airgas lists auto-darkening welding helmets by Miller, Lincoln Electric, ESAB, 3M Speedglas

name: Bee veil
definition: Mesh veil worn over the head and face by beekeepers.
notes: Dadant sells beekeeping veils: hood, square and round hat veils

name: Cap
definition: Brimmed or peaked head covering fitted to the head, without a full brim.
notes: END page names New Era caps; only the intro excerpt came back, no product list

name: Beanie
definition: Close-fitting knitted head covering with no brim.
notes: Carhartt sells knit beanies, cuffed and uncuffed; page also calls them acrylic watch caps

name: Safety glasses
definition: Eyewear made to protect the eyes from a hazard.
notes: Pyramex PMXSPEC, Intruder, Ztek safety glasses with ANSI Z87.1 impact rating

name: Ear defenders
definition: Ear muffs made to reduce noise reaching the ears.
notes: 3M Peltor over-the-head, behind-the-head and cap-mount earmuffs; Pyramex electronic earmuffs

name: Respirator
definition: Face-worn device made to filter or supply air against dust, fumes or gas.
notes: 3M 6000 Series reusable half-facepiece respirator with P100 filters, NIOSH

name: Face mask (medical or surgical)
definition: Mask worn over the nose and mouth for medical or surgical protection.
notes: iMask and Aurelia ASTM Level 3 earloop surgical masks sold in boxes of 50

name: Hat
definition: Head covering with a crown and a brim, or a shaped crown.
notes: Lock & Co sells trilbies, bowlers, Panamas, boaters, flat caps and smoking caps from London

name: Scarf
definition: Length of cloth or knitted fabric worn round the neck.
notes: Prince of Scots tartan scarves woven in merino lambswool

name: Necktie
definition: Strip of cloth worn round the collar and knotted at the front.
notes: Brooks Brothers sells ties in silk, cotton, wool; 128 results incl. bow ties and neckerchiefs

name: Arm sleeve
definition: Tube of fabric worn over the forearm or arm; one made for a sport is E2.
notes: UV Skinz sells UPF 50+ bamboo sun sleeves with thumbholes for gardening and driving; GripGrab cycling sleeves are sport

name: Arm warmer
definition: Tube of knitted fabric worn over the forearm for warmth.
notes: Pearl Izumi sells brushed thermal arm warmers for cycling; page separates them from UPF sun sleeves

name: Glove
definition: Covering for the hand with a separate sheath for each finger.
notes: Hestra sells ski gloves in 5-finger and 3-finger forms

name: Mitten
definition: Covering for the hand with one sheath for the thumb and one for the fingers.
notes: Hestra sells ski mittens, e.g. Army Leather Heli Ski mitt, CZone Mellow mitt

name: Belt
definition: Strip of leather, fabric or other material worn round the waist.
notes: Levi's lists 39 men belts, with prong, plaque-buckle, braid and reversible forms

name: Sash
definition: Wide band of cloth worn round the waist or over a shoulder.
notes: 1stDibs lists Japanese obi sashes in silk; individual vintage items

name: Belt buckle
definition: Buckle sold loose and made to be fitted to a belt.
notes: Wawak sells replacement belt buckles in metal and plastic as separate items

name: Collar stay
definition: Stiffener slipped into the underside of a shirt collar.
notes: Collar stays are a product category at Brooks Brothers and sold in packs by Charles Tyrwhitt

name: Detachable lining or hood
definition: Lining or hood made to be fitted to and removed from one garment.
notes: Barbour sells detachable waxed cotton hoods fitted by press studs, and coat liners

name: T-shirt
definition: Pullover top of jersey fabric with short or long sleeves and no collar or full-length front opening (a short neck placket, as on a Henley, is allowed).
notes: Uniqlo men's T-shirts category incl. long-sleeve, Henley, raglan, turtleneck T-shirts

name: Corset top
definition: Corset-shaped bustier or corset made to be worn visible as a top (a foundation corset is A1.5.1.03).
notes: NA-KD and Disturbia sell corset tops as visible tops (lace-up, strapless, bustier styles)

name: Button-up shirt
definition: Woven shirt with a collar and a full-length button front, in casual or smart-casual use.
notes: Uniqlo casual shirts: flannel shirts and Oxford/broadcloth button-down shirts

name: Dress shirt
definition: Woven shirt made to be worn with a tie or under a suit, with a stiffer collar and button cuffs or cufflink cuffs.
notes: Uniqlo dress shirts with regular, spread and button-down collars

name: Overshirt (shacket)
definition: Heavier shirt-construction garment worn as a light outer layer; a garment sold as a shacket with shirt construction.
notes: Overshirts and shackets sold as shirt-construction light outer layer (Selected: structured collars, buttoned cuffs)

name: Polo shirt
definition: Knit or piqué pullover shirt with a collar and a short button placket.
notes: Uniqlo polo shirts (pique); Lands' End polos

name: Kurta [kurti]
definition: Loose collarless or short-collared tunic shirt of South Asian dress, hip to knee length.
notes: Kalki sells men's kurta; collar styles mandarin; knee-length silhouettes kurti is an alias (shorter cut; length is an attribute; C11); kurta set is a named form (S3a). HVMK, R-70.

name: Pullover sweater
definition: Knitted top with no full-length front opening (a quarter-zip or button neck is allowed), worn as a mid layer or outer layer.
notes: Lands' End crew neck and V-neck pullover sweaters, cashmere, quarter-zip

name: Cardigan
definition: Knitted top with a front opening fastened by buttons, a zip or a tie, or left open.
notes: Cardigans incl. zip-through and shawl-collar cardigans; some sold as zip-through sweaters

name: Sweatshirt
definition: Pullover top of sweatshirt jersey with a ribbed neck, cuffs and hem and no hood.
notes: Uniqlo oversized sweatshirt sold in sweatshirts and hoodies category

name: Hoodie
definition: Sweatshirt-type top with an attached hood, with or without a front zip.
notes: Uniqlo pullover and full-zip hoodies

name: Fleece pullover
definition: pullover of napped synthetic pile with no full-length front opening (a short button, snap or zip neck is allowed); the material is the form.
notes: Uniqlo Fleece Button-Up Pullover (has a short placket; the tree definition says no front opening)

name: Jeans
definition: Five-pocket trousers of denim or denim-like twill; fit, weight and selvedge are attributes.
notes: Heddels guide to raw Japanese denim: five-pocket selvedge jeans; Wikipedia list of denim jeans brands

name: Chinos
definition: Lightweight cotton twill trousers with a flat front and slanted pockets.
notes: Uniqlo men's chinos: Slim Chino Pants, Barrel Chino Pants, Chino Shorts

name: Cargo trousers
definition: Trousers with large patch pockets on the thighs or legs.
notes: Carhartt cargo trousers category

name: Work pants
definition: Hard-wearing trousers made for work in cotton twill, duck or similar fabric.
notes: Dickies work pants (Original 874, double knee, carpenter)

name: Joggers
definition: Casual trousers of jersey or fleece with an elasticated or ribbed waist and ankle cuffs.
notes: Carhartt Relaxed Force Joggers listed with cargo trousers

name: Hakama
definition: Pleated, wide-legged or divided traditional Japanese trousers tied at the waist.
notes: Hakama sold as trousers (umanori divided) and skirt-cut andon-bakama

name: Chainsaw trousers
definition: Trousers with cut-resistant protective layers, worn for chainsaw work; hazard rating is an attribute.
notes: STIHL chainsaw cut-protection trousers, Design A Class 1 EN ISO 11393

name: Shorts
definition: Garment for the lower body with short legs ending at or above the knee.
notes: Uniqlo shorts incl. chino, cargo and utility shorts, jorts, culottes

name: Skirt
definition: Garment hanging from the waist or hips, open or closed below, without leg divisions; length and cut are attributes.
notes: Uniqlo skirts (pleated midi, tiered maxi, flare, mini, tennis) and skorts

name: Thermal pad
definition: solid sheet of thermal interface material cut to sit between a chip or drive and its cooler.
notes: ARCTIC TP-3 and TP-4 1 mm thermal pads sold beside MX-4 and MX-6 pastes

name: TV tuner card
definition: card fitted inside the computer that receives broadcast television.
notes: PCIe TV tuner cards: TBS6205, TBS6281SE; Hauppauge WinTV-quadHD four-tuner board

name: Macro pad
definition: separate input device of a few programmable keys, dials or sliders used for shortcuts, not for typing.
notes: Logitech MX Creative Console, dialpad and keypad, sold in Keyboards and Consoles category

name: Wide-format printer
definition: printer that prints on roll or sheet media wider than A3, for drawings and posters.
notes: HP DesignJet plotters and graphics printers in 24, 36, 44 and 64 inch widths

name: Range extender
definition: network device that receives a wireless signal and rebroadcasts it to widen coverage.
notes: TP-Link WiFi range extenders category: RE220, RE700X, Archer Air E5 and others

name: Powerline adapter
definition: adapter that carries a network connection over a building's mains wiring, sold in pairs or kits.
notes: TP-Link powerline adapters and starter kits: TL-PA7017, TL-PA9020P KIT

name: Modem
definition: device that connects a home network to a provider's cable, DSL, fibre or cellular line; one with a built-in router is this kind.
notes: ARRIS SURFboard DOCSIS 3.1 cable modems S34, S33, SB8200; no built-in Wi-Fi

name: PoE injector
definition: device that adds power to an Ethernet cable to feed a powered network device.
notes: Raspberry Pi PoE+ Injector, single-port 30 W, listed under Peripherals

name: DisplayPort cable
definition: cable with DisplayPort or Mini DisplayPort connectors.
notes: Cable Matters DisplayPort and Mini DisplayPort cables; StarTech DisplayPort cable category

name: Potentiometer
definition: loose variable resistor set by a shaft, slider or trimmer screw.
notes: Mouser category Potentiometers, Trimmers and Rheostats (46,515 products)

name: Thermistor
definition: loose resistor whose resistance changes with temperature (NTC or PTC).
notes: Mouser categories Thermistors - NTC and Thermistors - PTC

name: Varistor
definition: loose voltage-dependent resistor used to absorb surges.
notes: Mouser category Varistors (20,790 products), also under Circuit Protection

name: Transformer
definition: loose component that transfers power or signal between coils.
notes: Mouser category Transformers (22,219 products) and Audio/Signal Transformers

name: Crystal or oscillator
definition: loose frequency-control component (quartz crystal, resonator or oscillator).
notes: Mouser category Frequency Control and Timing Devices (297,356 products)

name: Diode
definition: loose semiconductor that lets current pass one way (rectifier, Zener, Schottky).
notes: Mouser category Diodes and Rectifiers under Discrete Semiconductors

name: LED
definition: loose light-emitting diode component for circuits (a lamp or bulb is B-lighting).
notes: Mouser category LEDs - Light Emitting Diodes (60,210 products); LED lamps are a separate category

name: Add-on board for a maker board
definition: board made to plug onto one maker-board family's header (HAT, shield, FeatherWing).
notes: Raspberry Pi Add-on boards category: AI HAT+, Sense HAT, PoE+ HAT, M.2 HAT+, DAC+

name: Laptop stand
definition: stand or riser without fans made to hold one laptop at a height or angle.
notes: Quill lists WorkEZ Best aluminium laptop stand and Kensington Easy Riser laptop riser under Laptop Stands

name: Overcoat
definition: tailored wool or wool-blend coat ending below the hip, worn over a suit or jacket.
notes: Gloverall tailored overcoats: Chesterfield, Hynes (Harris Tweed or wool), Selvon

name: Work jacket
definition: short hard-wearing jacket of duck canvas or similar, zip or button front, made for work; chore coat and trucker patterns keep their kinds.
notes: Carhartt WIP Detroit, Active and Santa Fe jackets, filed under Work Jackets style

name: Flight jacket (bomber)
definition: short jacket with a gathered or ribbed waist and cuffs in a flight or bomber pattern other than the MA-1 (A-2, B-15, CWU-45/P, G-1).
notes: Alpha Industries CWU 45/P and B-15 bomber jackets; Schott 184SM A-2 flight jacket

name: Anorak
definition: hooded pullover jacket of windproof or waterproof fabric with a part-length front opening.
notes: Fjallraven men's anoraks: Vardag Anorak, Anorak No. 8, Singi X-Anorak; quarter-zip hooded

name: Parka
definition: hooded insulated coat with a smooth outer shell, ending below the hip, cut for cold weather; a quilted face is the puffer coat.
notes: The North Face parkas: Men's McMurdo Parka, Women's Arctic Parka, hooded down-insulated

name: Field jacket
definition: hip-length military-style cotton jacket with four front pockets in a pattern other than the M-65 (M-43, M-51, safari-style).
notes: Buzz Rickson's Type M-1943 field jacket with four front pockets; Gloverall Oak Dufflewool Field Jacket

name: Pocket square
definition: square of cloth folded and worn in the breast pocket of a jacket.
notes: Brooks Brothers Silk Foulard, Silk Paisley and Wool Mini-Dot pocket squares

name: Face shield
definition: clear visor on a headband or hard-hat mount that protects the whole face from impact or splash.
notes: Page filter shows Face Shields (10) and Visors and Face Shields menu; no product named

name: Earplugs
definition: plugs worn in the ear canal to reduce noise reaching the ears.
notes: 3M Tri-Flange Cloth Corded Earplugs listed beside Peltor earmuffs

name: Balaclava
definition: close-fitting head covering that also covers the neck and part or all of the face.
notes: Snowears Balaclava Ski Masks collection: Tolasmik, RAUO, NANDN, BCG, Uhznus

name: Headband
definition: band of fabric or knit worn round the head or ears, held by its own elastic or ties.
notes: Nike Dri-FIT headbands (Fury Elevate, Swoosh Classic); Heat Holders knit thermal headbands

name: Shapewear
definition: elastic garment without boning worn under clothing to smooth or shape the figure; a boned shaping garment is the corset.
notes: SPANX shapewear bodysuits, shorts, tanks and camis in SPANXshape and SPANXsculpt ranges

name: Tank top (camisole)
definition: sleeveless top held by shoulder straps or narrow shoulders, of jersey or light fabric.
notes: Hanes Men's Cotton Tank Top and Muscle Tank; Uniqlo Cotton Dobby Camisole

name: Blouse
definition: woven top cut for women, with a placket, tie, yoke or collar detail but not a full collared button front; that is the button-up shirt.
notes: Uniqlo Rayon Blouse and Denim Blouse listed under Women's Shirts and Blouses

name: Tailored trousers
definition: trousers with a fly, waistband and pressed or flat front made for smart or formal wear, sold apart from a suit.
notes: Uniqlo Men's Dress Pants: Smart Pants, Smart Ankle Pants, Pleated Wide Pants

name: Leggings
definition: close-fitting stretch trousers without feet; footed versions are tights.
notes: Uniqlo Women's Leggings: Ultra Stretch Active Leggings, HEATTECH Leggings; footed tights listed separately

name: Culottes
definition: wide-legged trousers cut to hang like a skirt, ending between knee and ankle.
notes: Uniqlo Cotton Culottes, Denim Culottes and Nylon Culottes under Shorts and Culottes

name: Sweater vest
definition: sleeveless knitted top, pullover or buttoned.
notes: Lands' End Men's Performance Sweater Vest and Unisex Cotton Modal Pullover Sweater Vest

name: Chainsaw chaps
definition: cut-resistant leg aprons strapped over ordinary trousers for chainsaw work; hazard rating is an attribute.
notes: STIHL Professional Protection Chaps, FUNCTION Core 270 degree Chaps, Government and Utility Protective Chaps
